narr: An upper level disturbance produced widespread showers and thunderstorms across central Ohio during the overnight hours.
ev: A few cars were stuck on southbound I-71 near the intersection with I-670 due to flooding.
A vehicle was stranded in high water along Big Pine Road. Numerous roads were also closed throughout Benton and Laurel Townships due to high water. Some minor road damage was reported.
The westbound lanes of Interstate 70 were closed near the intersection with Interstate 71 due to high water.
